premise.claim: Issue #4222 (OPEN): JuiceFSRuntime should support hierarchical imagePullSecrets at spec level plus spec.worker and spec.fuse overrides; today only the controller-level IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS env default exists.
premise.reportedComponent: JuiceFSRuntime CRD / juicefs runtime pods (worker, fuse)
premise.patchedComponent: api/v1alpha1/juicefsruntime_types.go, pkg/ddc/juicefs transform, charts/juicefs worker+fuse templates
premise.evidence: On merge-base ff99142f, juicefsruntime_types.go has zero imagePullSecrets fields and charts/juicefs worker/fuse templates consume only .Values.imagePullSecrets; harness test file fails to COMPILE against base api/v1alpha1 (fields absent). See results/premise-base.log.

findings.note: round 4: contract re-scoped from "apply-in-one-pass-or-error" to the round-3 pre-accepted alternative fix (compare against the live templates): drift is never lost - every pass keeps reporting changed=true while blocked, and the worker converges once the worker-script configmap returns. RED on d7e316803, GREEN on be3337dd00.
round 4: a non-OnDelete worker strategy defers the template sync one pass; the worker must catch up on the next reconcile via the live-template diff. RED on d7e316803, GREEN on be3337dd00.

round 4: rotation a->b plus a worker override pinned to a must record the override even when the effective list is unchanged, so a later override removal falls back to b. RED on d7e316803, GREEN on be3337dd00.

round 5: pins the fuse rollout mechanism the docs must describe - default clean policy is OnRuntimeDeleted (CSI never cleans fuse pods eagerly) and syncFuseSpec enforces an OnDelete fuse DaemonSet, so a secrets sync updates the template and bumps the generation without restarting running fuse pods. GREEN on head 2150b49ef.

round 5: the docs commit 2150b49ef replaced the stale recreate-claim with 'the fuse pods are restarted' / 'fuse pod 会重启', which is inaccurate on the default configuration (OnDelete ds + OnRuntimeDeleted clean policy; see A11-fuse-rollout-is-lazy). RED on head 2150b49ef, GREEN once the sentence describes the lazy/on-replace behavior.

liveNote: L3 (skipped per debate policy): on a real cluster, create a JuiceFSRuntime with spec.imagePullSecrets and worker/fuse overrides and inspect the resulting worker StatefulSet / fuse DaemonSet pod specs.
